test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a code language, 'POCKET' is written as ‘VGMEQR’ and 'BUSH' is written as 'JUWD'. How will 'DESIRE' be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d9f2222d13f0d75477f5789fe34c986626f9d54f937ee85ec5f0db5452d8cd8.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

'POCKET' is written as ‘VGMEQR’ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2530d1d835c9a53a58fa27cc85f3a7b97c002a9b1cdd0d2ae5ba537fbdb7756b.png] 

'BUSH' is written as 'JUWD'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92997fdb6007423c6cc3579465a5e1486b29295a570cf56f9d9788cb0681e512.png] 

Similarly, 'DESIRE' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d7a85a0b21a1a0d17bd4d936b398eb94f02dbfe0cbbfb223ecfa2c0339ee561.png] 

Hence, **'option 4'** is the correct answer.
